link.description: Managing roles is essential for maintaining a secure and organized environment. This feature enables administrators to define and assign specific responsibilities, ensuring that each user has access to only the tools and information necessary for their role. By implementing a robust role management system, the application supports streamlined operations and enhances security across your organization. Explore how to create, edit, and assign roles effectively, aligning your team's access with their functions while adhering to best practices in user management. To view the list of all the roles, navigate to Administration > Roles & Permissions
